items.q: Can we listen to every call?
items.a: Yes. All calls are recorded and linked to the contact record in your CRM.

items.q: Which CRMs do you work in?
items.a: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive and Close. Other tools are possible after a short setup.

items.q: How fast can a campaign start?
items.a: Most campaigns place their first calls within two weeks and book first meetings in week three.
